title: Galaxy footer
description: A tall black footer in two halves: on the left the mark and five link groups under small uppercase headings on a two-column grid, social icons and an uppercase copyright line; on the right two latest-article cards, a podcast row with a square cover, and blocks of small uppercase, widely tracked legal text with white inline links. Phones stack it all, groups indented beside the mark.
notes: legal paragraphs take parts so single phrases can be links
social icons are passed in (lucide or your own svgs)
name: galaxy-footer
